author: IGN
description:
Rhabdom represents a major shift in Saros’ boss design, trading the multi-phase health bars of previous encounters for one massive, high-stakes life bar and extreme mobility. Unlike the stationary threats you've faced so far, Rhabdom is a relentless hunter that will constantly rush you, forcing you to master long dodges and utilize the arena's grapple points to survive. In this guide, we break down why bringing a weapon with Auto-hit enabled—like certain Handcannons or Shotguns—is essential for landing shots while you're sprinting for your life across the arena floor.

We’ll also detail the boss’s devastating red projectile slams and the mid-fight shift where blue, absorbable projectiles turn into lethal yellow waves. Success here requires managing your distance, knowing when to zip to the second floor for health-restoring aether, and timing your Overdrive shots to burn through Rhabdom’s health before he can pin you down. Stick around for a fully unedited successful encounter to see h
title: Saros: How to Defeat Rhabdom (Third Boss Guide)

description:
Forget what you think you know—the Forza Horizon series isn't just about racing; it’s an epic battle for the human soul. We’re getting newcomers and returning players up to speed with the full story of The Horizon Festival, which is not just a decadent motorsports event, but a bitter clash of competing visions for civilization. No, really. It might look like a 12 year-old's idea of what a car show is, but it's much, much deeper than that.

From the halcyon summer of Colorado in Forza Horizon 1 to the sun-soaked coasts of Mexico in FH5, we recap all the grand spectacle and highlight the more absurd showcase events in which the humble car asserted its dominance over air and sea. But the most bitter feud is fought on land: road vs. rail, a grudge match that spans the entire saga. We chart the car's continuous victories against locomotives like the sleek steam-powered passenger train, the diesel freight train, and the iconic Flying Scotsman. Finally, we look ahead to Forza Horizon 6 in Ja
title: Forza Horizon Recap - Yes, Seriously...

description:
Bastion serves as the formidable gatekeeper of the Ancient Depths, and while this stationary sentinel might seem simple at first, its grid-based attacks and area lockdowns can quickly overwhelm an unprepared player. To survive this encounter, you'll need to ditch your close-range shotguns in favor of rifles or handcannons and master the use of the arena's jump pads. This guide breaks down how to navigate the boss's lethal beam patterns and which Power Weapons, like Prominence or Dispiritor, will give you the edge at medium range.

We also dive into the transition phases, showing you the most efficient way to clear out turrets and recharge your resources before the intensity ramps up. Learn how to manage the "Shield Amplifier" trade-offs when absorbing yellow orbs and how to position yourself at the back of the arena to maximize your reaction time against Bastion's final phase lockdown. Stay tuned after the breakdown for a full, unedited successful run against Bastion to see these stra
title: Saros: How to Defeat Bastion (Second Boss Guide)

author: IGN
description: Colourful, quirky, and completely chaotic, Above Land: Rhapsody basically takes the three-player co-op carnage of Elden Ring Nightreign and injects it with some hilariously over-the-top weapons and special moves that seem straight out of a Yakuza street brawl. At a recent BiliBili: First Look event in Shanghai, I spent a few hours hacking and slashing away at monsters in a land above the clouds, in this frenetic roguelite that marries breathtaking bursts of action and exploration with a deep sense of combat customisation. Yet what really stood out for me was the creative combination of weaponry at my disposal. I mean, when was the last time you played an action RPG that allowed you to cut down goblins with a giant broadsword in one hand, and perform slam-dunking finishing moves with a basketball dribbled with the other? Previewed by Tristan Ogilvie
title: Above Land: Rhapsody is a Co-Op Roguelite That Mixes Swordplay with... Slam Dunks?
